canonical_title: Exterior field of view - Air vehicles with side-by-side pilots
subject_group: 9.4.4 External visibility and transmitted visual indications

versions.title_at_revision: Exterior field of view - Air vehicles with side-by-side pilots
versions.text:
Standard: The following are the minimum angles of unimpaired vision available to the pilot from the design eye positions in TABLE XII. TABLE XII. Exterior FOV - Air vehicles with side-by-side pilots. At 0° azimuth, at least 13° down and 12° up. 0° through 70° azimuth – at least 40° down and 40° up. Between 70° and 110° azimuth, provide 40° down and 90° up. 135° azimuth, at least 20° down. In the cockpit area inboard of each pilot’s centerlines, maximum vision with a minimum of obstruction should be provided. 90° left azimuth, and right azimuth provide at least 70° downward with the pilot leaning outboard from their respective design eye positions. Canopy bow vision obstruction within the area shown in TABLE XII does not exceed 2.0 inches in width when projected onto a plane perpendicular to a line between the structure and the design eye position. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analyze vision plots and verify that the total envelope (plus and minus 180 degrees in azimuth and plus and minus 90 degrees in elevation) from each pilot’s design eye box provides the required clear vision areas as described herein. Vision plots are completed for each pilot’s position for all their primary operations. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in flight that the external FOV allows the pilots to perform all their primary operations.
